definitions.gloss: to depict; to describe; to portray (in words, art, or film)
definitions.explanation: To represent something vividly through writing, painting, film, or other artistic media. Focuses on detailed, vivid representation rather than simple explanation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風景|ふうけい}→風景：03591_fuukei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{描写|びょうしゃ}する。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{悲惨|ひさん}→悲惨：12633_hisan⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{描写|びょうしゃ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This novel depicts the tragedy of war.

examples.japanese: ⟦{登場人物|とうじょうじんぶつ}→登場人物：16072_toujoujinbutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{心理|しんり}→心理：03332_shinri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{細|こま}かく→細かい：01245_komakai⟧{描写|びょうしゃ}する⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{作家|さっか}→作家：01414_sakka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧だ。
examples.english: It is characteristic of this author to describe the psychology of characters in fine detail.

notes:
A ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb from ⟦{描写|びょうしゃ}→描写：05516_byousha⟧, a compound of {描|びょう} (depict, draw) and {写|しゃ} (copy, capture). A key term in literary criticism, art, and film studies. Emphasizes vivid, detailed representation rather than simple description.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive — takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ to mark the thing being depicted.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{心理|しんり}{描写|びょうしゃ}→心理描写：18000_shinribyousha⟧ — psychological portrayal
- ⟦{情景|じょうけい}→情景：12676_joukei⟧⟦{描写|びょうしゃ}→描写：05516_byousha⟧ — scene description
- ⟦{人物|じんぶつ}{描写|びょうしゃ}→人物描写：23974_jinbutsubyousha⟧ — character portrayal
- ⟦{写実的|しゃじつてき}→写実的：17370_shajitsuteki⟧な⟦{描写|びょうしゃ}→描写：05516_byousha⟧ — realistic depiction
- {描写力|びょうしゃりょく} — descriptive power

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to express (broader, not limited to vivid representation)
- ⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧ — to draw, to depict (native Japanese, also used figuratively)
- ⟦{記述|きじゅつ}する→記述する：17347_kijutsusuru⟧ — to describe in writing (more factual, less artistic)
